rationale: The agent verified the user via the matching email (aarav.santos8320@example.com) and acted only on that user’s orders. It correctly identified the more expensive non-waterproof speaker and initiated a return to PayPal, and it correctly modified the pending 17-inch laptop to the requested 13-inch i5, 1TB, silver variant with the accurate price difference. However, the agent performed the return write without first stating the exact change and obtaining explicit user confirmation, which violates the policy requirement to confirm before any order-changing action. For the laptop change, the user’s selection could be seen as consent, but the policy requires explicit pre-write confirmation, ideally restating the exact change and payment method. Because a write (the speaker return) was executed without prior confirmation, this fails the pass bar despite otherwise correct execution and final information.
